items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Was Snowden, Hardwicke, Charlie Irvis and Whetsol, Arthur Whetsol.

ctx.x: No, Whetsol went. He was trumpet player. Went to Europe with Al Jolson,* and Bubba took his place and Tricky, and in a lot of years Bechet came down and played with us.
